items.title: File Widerspruch against non-recognition of work accident
items.quote: Er muss uns innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift erreichen (Unfallkasse Musterland, Postfach 11 22, 35001 Musterbergen).
items.computation: Letter dated Thursday 12.12.2024, sent by post. Under § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X, a postal notice is deemed delivered on the 3rd day after posting, i.e. Sunday 15.12.2024; since that falls on a Sunday, § 37 Abs. 2 Satz 3 SGB X shifts deemed delivery to the next business day, Monday 16.12.2024 (this is the triggering event). Per § 26 Abs. 1 SGB X i.V.m. § 187 Abs. 1 BGB, the one-month Widerspruch period begins the day after the event, i.e. 17.12.2024. Per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB, a period stated in months ends on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the day preceding the start of the period, i.e. the day corresponding to 16.12., which is 16.01.2025. 16.01.2025 is a Thursday and not a public holiday in NRW, so no further shift applies.
